examShortTricks: Trick 1: Electrode half-reactions: anode = oxidation (LEO), cathode = reduction (GER) — in a galvanic cell the anode is NEGATIVE; in electrolysis it is POSITIVE — the sign flip is the classic trap.
Trick 2: Cell notation order: anode | anode solution || cathode solution | cathode — salt bridge as the double line; write one example: Zn|Zn²⁺||Cu²⁺|Cu.
Trick 3: Electron flow: external circuit anode → cathode; current convention is opposite; ions migrate through the bridge to keep neutrality.
